summary: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting a fatal accident at its Reserva mine in Bolivia. The release describes the incident, expresses condolences, notes a suspension of activities in the affected area, and states that an investigation is underway. No financial terms, M&A activity, shareholder vote, board change, or capital event are involved. This is an operational disclosure with no special-situation corporate action.
